nodes.name: Pull production volumes and material costs
nodes.rationale: AI can assist in data extraction but human oversight is needed for context and accuracy.

nodes.name: Reconcile production volumes and material costs
nodes.rationale: AI can help identify discrepancies, but human judgment is required to investigate variances.

nodes.name: Allocate overhead
nodes.rationale: Overhead allocation by a fixed rule can be fully automated.

nodes.name: Prepare cost-of-goods journal entry
nodes.rationale: AI can draft the journal entry, but a human must review for accuracy and compliance.

nodes.name: Review and approve journal entry
nodes.rationale: This process requires human judgment and approval.

nodes.name: Generate closing report
nodes.rationale: AI can assist in generating reports from templates, but human input is needed for finalization.

nodes.name: Distribute closing report
nodes.rationale: The distribution of reports via email can be fully automated.
